description: This source file contains a static helper class ReadOnlySequenceHelper that provides extension methods for working with sequences of bytes, including batching, conversion to ReadOnlySequence, and sequence creation from buffers.

classes.name: ReadOnlySequenceHelper
classes.description: A static utility class providing extension methods to facilitate batching and creating ReadOnlySequence instances from various byte collection types.

classes.name: ReadOnlyBufferSegment
classes.description: A nested class extending ReadOnlySequenceSegment<byte>, used internally to create linked segments for ReadOnlySequence from multiple buffers.

methods.name: Batch
methods.description: Divides an IEnumerable<byte> into batches of specified size, returning them as an enumerable of byte arrays.

methods.name: ToReadOnlySequence
methods.description: Converts an IEnumerable<byte[]> or IEnumerable<Memory<byte>> into a ReadOnlySequence<byte>.

methods.name: CreateReadOnlySequence
methods.description: Creates a ReadOnlySequence<byte> from an array of byte arrays, linking them into a sequence of segments.
